newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mixed, marks and yen down.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mixed, marks and yen down.

text.p: Nov 5 - IMM currency futures ended mixed, with marks, Swiss francs and yen settling lower. Dec yen managed to inch above support at $0.008806, or 114.20 spot. Sterling held slim gains, reflecting its dominance on cash cross rates. Expectations Republicans will maintain control of Congress contributed to dollar's bid ahead of U.S. election results. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
